title: Text: DET Tom Moore ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Greetings, Tom...If schedule allows it, could I get 20 min with you in office tomorrow? For my season preview story

I can call you on the way home from park and explain the story. Basically, it's a profile on Al's team, the seven guys who are tasked with the rebuild. You, Scott Bream, David Chadd, Littlefield, Jay Sartori, Scott Pleis

Short stories on who you guys are, what you do, and Id like to get anecdotes on working for Al and the loyalty of the "team." The goal is to show the readers that  you all are baseball guys and have a bunch of experience, so org is in good hands.
No problem Anthony. I will be around all day tomorrow.
Cool. I'm going to see Littlefield at 11 am. Any time work best for you?
Would it work to stop in after that?
Yep, would be perfect. I will text you
